seo.title: Request an Appointment | Valencia Dentistry
seo.description: Request a dental appointment in Valencia, Santa Clarita. Book online in seconds or send your details and we'll confirm a time. $59 new patient exam.

sections.heading: Book your visit with Dr. Moezzi.
sections.lead: Choose a time instantly with online booking, or send a request and we'll confirm the earliest slot that suits you. Same-day appointments are often available.

sections.heading: Prefer we call you?
sections.lead: Fill in the form and a member of our team will reach out to confirm your appointment.

sections.heading: Your first visit, step by step

items.title: 1. A warm welcome
items.text: Arrive a few minutes early for a short health history. Bring your ID, insurance card and current medications.

items.title: 2. A thorough exam
items.text: Digital X-rays, an oral cancer screening and an unhurried exam with Dr. Moezzi.

items.title: 3. A plan you understand
items.text: Clear options, honest priorities and a written estimate before anything begins.

sections.heading: Where to find us
sections.lead: 27420 Tourney Rd, Suite 240, Santa Clarita, CA 91355. Free parking on site.
